answer: Social Matters >> Education & Upbringing Question ID: 14045 Country: India Title: Asalamualaikum wa rahmatullahe wabaratuh 1- Over here in some Schools Religious education is compulsory for Muslims, so the teachers take the children to see Masjids,Church,Mandir,Temple etc my question is that is it permissible for the children to go inside the Church,Mandir,Temple etc? 2-Is there any sahih hadith which forbids Muslims from going inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 3-Is it haram and a Sin to go inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? Question: Asalamualaikum wa rahmatullahe wabaratuh 1- Over here in some Schools Religious education is compulsory for Muslims, so the teachers take the children to see Masjids,Church,Mandir,Temple etc my question is that is it permissible for the children to go inside the Church,Mandir,Temple etc? 2-Is there any sahih hadith which forbids Muslims from going inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? 3-Is it haram and a Sin to go inside a Church,Mandir etc to have a look? Answer ID: 14045 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1103/1103=M/1430) Muslim children should not be given education in schools where the education of other religions is compulsory for students. The scholars of Fiqh have regarded it makrooh (undesirable) to visit the church, mandir (temple) and worship-place of other religions, it is explicitly mentioned in Shami and other books. Muslim children also should not be taken to temples. (2) I do not remember any Hadith regarding the same. (3) It is makrooh tahreemi. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
